requirements.statement: A Viewer can sign in with their organizational account to access the task board

criteria.must: An unauthenticated visitor is directed to sign in before seeing the board
A Viewer who signs in successfully reaches the task board

requirements.statement: A Viewer can see the full list of tasks and whether each is complete

criteria.must: The task board shows every task in the system to a signed-in Viewer
Each task's complete/not-complete status is visibly displayed

requirements.statement: An Admin can sign in with their organizational account to manage tasks

criteria.must: An Admin who signs in successfully reaches the task board

requirements.statement: An Admin can create a new task with a title that appears on the board for everyone

criteria.must: An Admin can submit a new task with a title
A newly created task appears in the task list visible to Viewers
A Viewer cannot create a new task

requirements.statement: An Admin can see the full list of tasks and their status to decide what needs attention

criteria.must: The task board shows every task and its status to a signed-in Admin

requirements.statement: An Admin can mark a task as complete, updating the board for everyone

criteria.must: An Admin can mark an open task as complete
A task marked complete by an Admin shows as complete to a Viewer
A Viewer cannot mark a task as complete
